name: Wo Wei Ge Kuang: Xia Ri Cai Hong
source:
They are active, curious, passion, happiness, sadness... and they own the whole world. Music was their interest, hobby, and their way to interpreting the world. However... The storm of their life comes without warning. Can they see the rainbow after the storm?

The whole story begins with a shipwreck. Ye Feng and his friends is going to the music competition, so they have a trip to Hainan for inspiration. However, they have a great storm and shipwreaked on the way. When they wake up, they find themselves on an isolated island, where is called Paradise Island. After their arrival, a thousand-year seal is breaking, and their adventures begin...

Music Up: Summer Rainbow is an adventure game loosely based on the Chinese animated series Music Up, featuring the characters from the series, similar to Sakura Wars series.
translation:
他们活跃、好奇、热情、快乐、悲伤……他们拥有整个世界。音乐是他们的兴趣、爱好，也是他们解释世界的方式。然而……他们人生的风暴毫无预兆地来临了。风雨过后他们能看到彩虹吗？

整个故事是从一次海难开始的。叶枫和他的朋友们要去参加音乐比赛，所以他们去海南寻找灵感。然而，他们在途中遭遇了巨大的风暴和船难。当他们醒来时，发现自己身处一座孤岛，名叫天堂岛。他们到来后，一千年的封印被打破，他们的冒险开始了……

Music Up: Summer Rainbow是一款大致基于中国动画系列Music Up的冒险游戏，以该系列中的角色为特色，类似于樱花大战系列。
